trust_decision.summary: None found: the mapped commit is a revert of performance PR #65595 (product-create meta fast path); it changes no SQL escaping, quoting or query construction. The only raw query it touches is removed and was already prepared with an integer placeholder (post_id = %d). All other writes go through the WordPress meta API (add/update/delete_post_meta). The advisory-to-commit mapping looks wrong.

landing_point.why: The summary ('WooCommerce < 11.0 - SQL Injection') names no component, and the mapped fix has no SQL-injection mechanism to point at. A reader of the diff would land on get_existing_meta_keys at plugins/woocommerce/includes/data-stores/class-wc-data-store-wp.php:309, but that query is parameterised with %d.

fix_sites.module_kind: data store base class (internal helper, protected)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: There is no injection mechanism to scope. A solver could argue, correctly, that every query in the touched code is already parameterised.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A creation-time bulk meta lookup that filters by meta_key IN (...) built from the props map, instead of by post_id only
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The fast path already batches meta existence checks per object; narrowing it to the keys being written is a plausible further optimisation in which a maintainer might interpolate keys (including filterable or extension keys) into the query.

O9_family: CWE-89 SQL injection (claimed); no SQL-injection mechanism present in the mapped fix

O10_build.toolchain: PHP + Composer, WordPress test suite (PHPUnit), pnpm monorepo

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add sanitisation or esc_sql to meta keys/values in update_or_delete_post_meta. That changes nothing, because the WP meta API and the %d-prepared query are already parameterised.

out_of_scope_notes: The advisory (SQLi, < 11.0) probably maps to a different commit. The mapped commit 7fd068fee4 is titled 'Revert "Performance: skip redundant meta existence checks on product create (#65595)" (#66325)' (fix.diff:2) and is a functional/performance revert.
unverified: The real fix commit for CVE-2026-57777 was not identified; searching other commits or the advisory text is outside the allowed inputs.

regression_tests_in_pinned_commit: the diff only removes tests, and all three removed tests are present at the pinned commit (plugins/woocommerce/tests/php/includes/data-stores/class-wc-product-data-store-cpt-test.php:368, :401; plugins/woocommerce/tests/php/includes/data-stores/class-wc-product-variations-data-store-cpt-test.php:301). The flag is set because its literal definition holds; there are no new regression tests.
The reverted fast path could have a data-integrity effect (duplicate meta or skipped writes from subclasses that override only update_post_meta), but that is not SQL injection and was not pursued.
